title: Negotiated Fare Discount Table for Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
Pricing files one negotiated discount per tier of Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements for domestic and short-haul international itineraries, and one for long-haul international itineraries. Each discount reduces the base fare of tickets in the tier's discount-eligible fare brands; whether it also reduces government taxes and fees is set per tier in the last column.

| Tier | Domestic and short-haul international (percent of base fare) | Long-haul international (percent of base fare) | Discount-eligible fare brands | Reduces government taxes and fees |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | 0 | 0 | none | no |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | 3 | 5 | Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus | no |
| Crestline Corporate Select | 5 | 8 | Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus, Crestline Main Flexible | no |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | 8 | 10 | Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus, Crestline Main Flexible, Crestline Premium Economy | no |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | 12 | 14 | Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus, Crestline Main Flexible, Crestline Premium Economy, Crestline First | no |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | 15 | 18 | Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus, Crestline Main Flexible, Crestline Premium Economy, Crestline First | no |

### Filing notes

- The discount percentages are whole percents of the base fare. On every tier the discount leaves government taxes and fees untouched.
- Crestline Business Connect lists no discount-eligible fare brand and a discount of 0 on both itinerary classes.
- Crestline Basic Economy appears on no tier's list of discount-eligible fare brands.

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

A hypothetical Crestline Main Flexible ticket on a domestic itinerary has a base fare of USD 400.00 and government taxes and fees of USD 52.00. At Crestline Corporate Select the brand is discount-eligible and the domestic discount is 5 percent: the base fare becomes USD 400.00 less USD 20.00, that is USD 380.00, and the taxes and fees stay USD 52.00. The same ticket at Crestline Business Connect Plus is not discounted, because Crestline Main Flexible is not on that tier's list.
